tools.name: list_programs
tools.title: List programs
tools.description: List the Refugee Basketball Initiative's public youth programs, with a summary and highlights for each.

slug.description: Optional program slug to return a single program, e.g. 'her-on-court'.

tools.name: list_events
tools.title: List upcoming events
tools.description: List the upcoming public events (workshops, camps and tournaments) run by the Refugee Basketball Initiative.

limit.description: Optional maximum number of events to return.

tools.name: get_impact
tools.title: Get impact figures
tools.description: Get the organisation's published impact statistics (youth reached, players trained, scholarships) and the outcome areas behind them.

tools.name: list_stories
tools.title: List success stories
tools.description: List published success stories from young people in the programs, optionally filtered by tag (scholarship, empowerment, community).

tools.name: get_support_options
tools.title: Get ways to support
tools.description: Get the published ways to support the organisation: donation tiers with what each amount funds, plus volunteering and partnership options.

tools.name: get_contact_info
tools.title: Get contact information
tools.description: Get the organisation's public contact details (locations, email, phone) and the list of pages on the website.
